server_path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom maa-lsp server. Customize this setting instead of `command`; use `auto` to run the server bundled with this package.

maa_version.markdownDescription: Semantic version of `@maaxyz/maa-node` installed into this package's managed storage for task execution.

maa_log_tools_version.markdownDescription: Version of the official `@windsland52/maa-log-tools` package installed into this package's managed storage for MaaLogAnalyzer runtime inspection.

npm_registry.markdownDescription: npm registry used to install the selected MaaFramework native runtime and optional MaaLogAnalyzer tools.

debug_mode.markdownDescription: Enable MaaFramework native debug logging for runtime sessions.

admin_mode.markdownDescription: Require an elevated Sublime Text process before starting the MaaFramework worker on Windows.

save_draw.markdownDescription: Ask MaaFramework to save recognition drawing output in the project debug directory.

break_tasks.markdownDescription: Per-project pipeline task breakpoints managed by the control panel.

agent_timeout.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait for each MaaFramework Agent client to connect.
